text: It's a great keyboard, and I like it, but voice typing doesn't work whenever I'm texting people using my regular phone number. It works in other apps, like YouTube, but when I start texting people using voice typing, it says, "Weak connection." Is there a way to fix this?
replyText: Hi James, thanks for the feedback! We've made fixes since 1.3.1, including voice input stability improvements. Please update to the latest version and try again. If the issue persists, send us feedback directly in the app — thanks for your patience!
